name: Infel
source:
Likes: Reading books, jokes
Dislikes: Dumb people, insistent people

[url=/c55886]Cloche's[/url] Mind Guardian. She is very business-like and places efficiency above anything else. She always mocks others with harsh remarks like, "You're so stupid," or "Are you dumb?" She even treats her master, Cloche, severely because of her functionalist personality.
